done_when: a statement-domain selection whose month filter names one month becomes or matches the selection's period instead of being rejected as unsupported, so 'What was the Actual for each MIS statement line in July 2026?' reliably reaches the plant picker; leaves in bedrock.provider.test.ts

findings.body: The added regression tests invoke only `BedrockLlmProvider.select()` and assert the mapped selection. None passes the recorded Bedrock response through `ChatService.ask()` for the exact question or asserts that a multi-plant user receives `plantChoice`. Existing Ask coverage constructs an already-valid selection through a fake LLM, so it would still pass if the provider-to-Ask integration rejected or lost this response. The required user-facing behavior therefore remains proven only at the provider unit boundary, not at the real Ask entry point.
findings.title: Not done: the exact July statement question reaches the plant picker through the real Ask entry point

why: Statement questions fail when the live model adds a month filter to a domain without a month field
